functions.name: audit
calls:
con.execute(text("SELECT CASE
                WHEN password_hash ~ '^[0-9a-f]{32}:[0-9a-f]{64}$' THEN 'legacy_pbkdf2_sha256_310000'
                ELSE 'unknown_requires_private_review' END AS format,count(*)
                FROM clubhost.hosts GROUP BY 1")).all

con.execute(text("SELECT c.relname AS table_name,
                k.conname AS name,k.contype AS type,pg_get_constraintdef(k.oid) AS definition
                FROM pg_constraint k JOIN pg_class c ON c.oid=k.conrelid
                JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace WHERE n.nspname='clubhost'
                ORDER BY c.relname,k.conname")).mappings

con.execute(text("SELECT sequencename,data_type,\n                start_value,min_value,max_value,increment_by,cycle,cache_size\n                FROM pg_sequences WHERE schemaname='clubhost' ORDER BY sequencename")).mappings

con.execute(text("SELECT table_name,column_name,
                ordinal_position,data_type,udt_name,is_nullable,column_default,character_maximum_length,
                is_identity,identity_generation FROM information_schema.columns
                WHERE table_schema='clubhost' ORDER BY table_name,ordinal_position")).mappings
con.execute(text("SELECT tablename,indexname,indexdef\n                FROM pg_indexes WHERE schemaname='clubhost' ORDER BY tablename,indexname")).mappings

con.execute(text("SELECT
                count(*) FILTER (WHERE access_key<>'') AS plaintext_booking_keys,
                count(*) FILTER (WHERE token_nonce='') AS bookings_without_nonce,
                count(*) FILTER (WHERE token_expires_at IS NULL) AS bookings_without_expiry
                FROM clubhost.bookings")).mappings

con.execute(text("SELECT
                count(*) FILTER (WHERE access_key<>'') AS plaintext_booking_keys,
                count(*) FILTER (WHERE token_nonce='') AS bookings_without_nonce,
                count(*) FILTER (WHERE token_expires_at IS NULL) AS bookings_without_expiry
                FROM clubhost.bookings")).mappings().one

migrations.summary:
Create ClubHost tables inside its dedicated PostgreSQL schema only.

Revision ID: 0001_initial
Revises:
Create Date: 2026-10-27
Record member gender without guessing existing members' gender.
Optional male/female session prices and stable booking fee snapshots.
Host workspace, recurring sessions, private payments and account operations.

Sport catalog code and club defaults, preserving legacy fees and bookings.

Legacy product scope is exclusively badminton (README / BUILD_PLAN).
No session or financial data is backfilled or reinterpreted by this revision.

Whole-group registrations, session policy snapshots and hashed capabilities.

Expand first: legacy plaintext is retained until the new application is deployed.
The operator then runs scrub_booking_tokens; old links continue via their digest.
Per-person attendance, session lifecycle and future charge issue freeze.
Add immutable issued charges and manual receipts; preserve every legacy money row.
Append-only charge adjustments, scoped co-host permissions, separate SaaS ledger.
Snapshot static QR and bank details together, including monthly obligations.
Per-session defaults for registered fixed members; retain historical dues.
